pf. with present meaning (hence imperfect = plpf.), to have come, be present: Mat.24.50, Mrk.8.3 (late pf., ἧκα, see Swete, in l; WH, App., 169), Luk.12.46; 15.27, Jhn.8.42, Heb.10.7, 9; 10.37, I Jhn.5.20, Rev.2.25; 3.3, 9; 15.4; before ἀπό, with genitive loc., Mat.8.11, Luk.13.29; ἐκ, Rom.11.26 id. before εἰς, Jhn.4.47 μακρόθεν, Mrk.8.3 ἐπί, with accusative, Rev.3.3. ἡλεί (Rec. ἠλί L, ἠλί; Heb. אֵל), 
Eli, my God: Mat.27.46 (cf. ἐλωΐ).†
(AS)

Ἡλεί (Rec. Ἡλί; RV, Ἡλί), ὁ, indecl., 
Heli, Joseph's father: Luk.3.23.†
(AS)

ἡλικία, -ας, ἡ
(ἧλιξ, of the same age, mature), [in LXX: Ezk.13.18 (קוֹמָה), Job.29.18, Wis.4.9, Sir.26.17, frequently in 2-4 Mac ;] 
always of age or maturity; "a stage of growth whether measured by age or stature"; 
__1. (a) age: Mat.6.27, Luk.12.25 (R, mg.), Heb.11.11 
__(b) full age, maturity: Jhn.9.21, 23, Eph.4.13. 
__2. stature: Luk.19.3 (Mat.6.27, Luk.12.25, AV, R, txt.; but the prevailing usage in LXX and…

ἡλίκος, -η, -ον 
__1. prop., as big as, as old as. 
__2. As indirect interrog., what sized, what, how great, how small (the sense to be determined by the context): Col.2.1, Jas.3.5, Gal.6.11 (WH, mg.; πηλ-, WH, txt., RV).†
(AS)

ἧλος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Isa.41.7 מַסְמֵר etc. ;] 
a nail: Jhn.20.25.†
(AS)
